annotations.title: Check if URLs are indexed in Google (spends credits)

description: Check whether Google has indexed each URL. THIS SPENDS CREDITS: 3 credits per URL. Before you call this tool, tell the user how many URLs will be checked and the credit cost, and wait for a clear yes. Send urls, or batch_id to check the URLs of an earlier submission. Only an exact match of the URL counts as indexed. Results arrive in 5 to 30 minutes: use get_index_check with the check_id. URLs not found get one free recheck after 3 days. A "not_found" result means Google did not show the page yet; it may still be indexed later.

batch_id.description: Check the sent URLs of this submission instead of a URL list.

urls.description: The URLs to index, each starting with http:// or https://. Up to 5,000. Duplicates and invalid lines are removed and not charged.
